title: Grade 3 Science — Mon, Jun 01
description: Animal Life — Day 1 of 5: Birds and their features
subject: science

questions.question: Which body covering helps birds fly?
questions.explanation: Birds have feathers and wings that help them fly.

questions.question: A bird's mouth is called a:
questions.explanation: Birds have a hard mouth called a beak, which they use to pick up food.

questions.question: Birds bring out their young ones by laying:
questions.explanation: Birds lay eggs, and the baby birds hatch out of the eggs.

questions.question: How many legs do birds have?
Which of these is a bird that CANNOT fly?
questions.explanation: An ostrich is a bird, but it is too big and heavy to fly. It runs very fast instead.

questions.question: A bird that swims in water and has webbed feet is the:
questions.explanation: Ducks have webbed feet that help them paddle and swim in water.

questions.question: An eagle has a sharp, curved beak because it:
questions.explanation: Birds of prey like eagles have sharp, hooked beaks to tear the flesh of the animals they eat.

questions.question: Which part of a bird helps it balance and change direction while flying?
questions.explanation: A bird's tail helps it balance and steer while flying.

questions.question: Baby birds come out of eggs by a process called:
questions.explanation: When a baby bird breaks out of its egg, we say the egg has hatched.

questions.question: A parrot has a strong, curved beak that helps it:
questions.explanation: Parrots use their strong curved beaks to crack open hard seeds and nuts.

questions.question: Birds keep their bodies light for flying because their bones are:
questions.explanation: Birds have hollow, light bones, which help them fly easily.

questions.question: Which of these animals is a bird?
questions.explanation: A peacock is a bird with feathers, wings and a beak. A bat is a mammal and a butterfly is an insect.

questions.question: Why do most birds build nests?
options: To lay eggs and keep their young safe
questions.explanation: Birds build nests to lay their eggs and keep their baby birds safe.

questions.question: A woodpecker has a strong pointed beak to:
options: Make holes in tree trunks to find insects
questions.explanation: Woodpeckers use their strong pointed beaks to drill into tree bark and find insects.

questions.question: Which feature is common to all birds?
options: They all have feathers and a beak
questions.explanation: All birds have feathers and a beak, even if some, like the ostrich, cannot fly.
